# The apps file that scripts/capture-contract.sh gives a real agent. It holds at least one of everything the dashboard
# reads: the spellings of schema v1 for apps (ports, release steps of each kind, builds with presets, previews, a nested
# database), jobs of each kind, databases with backups and one without, notifications, registries, proxy sites, build
# limits. Nothing here is deployed except `worker`, by the capture itself; the Caddy admin address is one nobody listens
# on, so the agent starts without a Caddy and says so.
managed_postgres: {version: 17, port: 5443, memory: 1g}
registries:
  - {host: ghcr.io, username: bot, password_file: /work/etc/ghcr-token}
proxy:
  admin: "http://127.0.0.1:2019"
  acme_email: ops@example.com
  tls: internal
  access_log: /var/log/caddy/access.log
  trusted_proxies: [103.21.244.0/22, '2400:cb00::/32']
  client_ip_header: CF-Connecting-IP
  certificates:
    - {cert_file: /work/etc/origin.pem, key_file: /work/etc/origin.key}
  sites:
    - hosts: [Static.Example.com]
      root: /var/www/static
      not_found: 404.html
      immutable: ["/_next/static/*"]
      headers: {X-Frame-Options: DENY}
    - hosts: [old.example.com]
      redirect: {to: "https://new.example.com{uri}", code: 301}
    - hosts: [api.example.com]
      upstream: "127.0.0.1:9000"
notifications:
  name: contract
  events: [deployment.failed, job.failed, disk.high, job.missed]
  webhooks:
    - {url: "<hidden>", secret_file: /work/etc/hook-secret}
  telegram: {bot_token_file: /work/etc/telegram-token, chat_id: "-100123"}
  disk_alert_percent: 90
  memory_alert_percent: 8
  alert_cooldown: 0s
apps:
  # A blue/green app with a managed database, a backup release step, a host step and a container step with its own image.
  - name: shop
    project: shop
    environment: production
    image: ghcr.io/acme/shop
    env: {NODE_ENV: "<hidden>"}
    env_file: /work/etc/shop.env
    domains: [Shop.Example.com, www.shop.example.com]
    port: 3000
    health_path: /healthz
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_timeout: 45s
    health_timeout: 2m
    stable_after: 20s
    drain: 0s
    soak: 45s
    verify:
      - {path: /}
      - {path: /login, status: 302}
    keep_images: 5
    log: {driver: local, max_size: 50m, max_file: 5}
    release:
      on_rollback: true
      steps:
        - {name: backup, backup: shop}
        - {name: migrate, container: {command: [node, migrate.js], image: ghcr.io/acme/shop-tools}, timeout: 5m}
        # `run` is the legacy spelling of `host`: the agent reads it and reports a deprecation.
        - {name: warm, run: [/srv/warm.sh], dir: /srv, continue_on_failure: true}
    build:
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.keelson
      context: web
      target: runtime
      args: {NODE_ENV: production}
      timeout: 20m
      memory: 3g
      cpus: 1.5
      max_source: 1g
      database: true
      platform: linux/amd64
      source_hosts: [github.example.com]
    previews:
      domain: "pr-{pr}-shop.example.com"
      env_file: /work/etc/shop-preview.env
      env: {NODE_ENV: staging}
      ttl: 72h
      max: 5
    database:
      password_file: "/work/data/postgres/roles/shop"
      backups:
        schedule: "0 3 * * *"
        recipients: ["age1wn7dkjxred46y40slmr4jpdxm30958ehls6lmr58d6tv7xe05ggqyfu7qk"]
        destinations: [{local: {dir: "/work/backups"}}]
  # A plain app with published ports, volumes and a command, no routing. The capture deploys it.
  - name: worker
    image: ghcr.io/acme/worker
    command: [worker, --queue, default]
    publish: ["127.0.0.1:9000:9000"]
    volumes: ["/srv/worker:/data:ro"]
    restart: always
    stop_timeout: 5s
  # A host-network app switched blue/green on two ports, with a variable of its own for the port.
  - name: legacy
    image: keelson-local/legacy
    network: host
    domains: [legacy.example.com]
    port:
      host: [4000, 4001]
      env: LISTEN_PORT
    restart: "no"
  # Fixed published ports, so the old version stops before the new one starts.
  - name: tools
    image: ghcr.io/acme/tools
    publish: ["127.0.0.1:9100:9100", "5353:5353/udp"]
    network: keelson-net
    deploy: {strategy: replace}
    health_timeout: 30s
  # One app of each preset of the build.
  - name: web
    project: web
    image: ghcr.io/acme/web
    port: 3000
    domains: [web.example.com]
    build: {preset: nextjs, standalone: true, args: {NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: "https://api.example.com"}}
    source: {repo: acme/web, branch: main, deploy_on: workflow, workflow: deploy.yml, previews_workflow: previews.yml, build_on: [push, pull_request], build_server: builder}
  - name: api
    image: ghcr.io/acme/api
    port: 3000
    domains: [api-app.example.com]
    build: {preset: node, start: node dist/server.js, node: "22"}
  - name: docs
    image: ghcr.io/acme/docs
    port: 8080
    domains: [docs.example.com]
    build: {preset: static, output_dir: public, spa: false}
  - name: site
    image: ghcr.io/acme/site
    port: 8080
    domains: [site.example.com]
    build: {preset: vite}
jobs:
  - {name: purge, schedule: "@daily", host: [/srv/purge.sh, --older-than, 30d], dir: /srv, timezone: Europe/Paris, timeout: 10m, alert_after: 3, realert_after: 0s}
  - {name: warm-cache, schedule: "*/15 * * * *", container: {app: shop, command: [node, warm.js]}, paused: true}
  - name: ping
    schedule: "@every 10m"
    http:
      url: "https://shop.example.com/api/ping"
      method: post
      headers: {X-Source: "<hidden>"}
      body: "<hidden>"
      bearer: {file: /work/etc/ping-token}
      expect_status: [200, 204]
    realert_after: 12h
databases:
  # An existing PostgreSQL server, backed up to two places.
  - name: ledger
    host: db.internal
    port: 5433
    database: ledger
    user: app
    password_file: /work/etc/db-ledger
    ssl_mode: require
    version: 16
    network: keelson-net
    backups:
      schedule: "30 3 * * *"
      timezone: Europe/Paris
      recipients: ["age1wn7dkjxred46y40slmr4jpdxm30958ehls6lmr58d6tv7xe05ggqyfu7qk"]
      keep: 30
      keep_days: 90
      keep_pre_deploy: 2
      timeout: 1h
      alert_after: 2
      destinations:
        - local: {dir: "/work/backups"}
        - s3: {endpoint: "https://s3.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com", region: eu-west-3, bucket: acme-backups, prefix: ledger, access_key_id: AKIAEXAMPLE, secret_key_file: /work/etc/s3-secret}
  # An existing server nothing backs up.
  - name: native
    host: db2.internal
    database: native
    user: app
    password_file: /work/etc/db-native
build_limits: {memory: 4g, cpus: 4, timeout: 30m, max_source: 512m, host_network: true}

deprecations.message: the top-level previews section is deprecated: previews are a key of their app, apps[blog].previews (without app)
